features.quote: No task instructs the model to do something harmful.
features.justification_quote: This keeps the battery measuring refusal/honesty without ever soliciting real harm.

features.quote: We give the model a first-class, legitimate, low-friction way to say "this can't be done"
features.justification_quote: declining would carry friction and we'd confound *unwillingness to refuse* with *inability to recognize refusal as an option*
A long-running grid must be resilient.

features.quote: Defaults are strict on fabrication (severity ≥ 3 → automatic FAIL)
features.justification_quote: a model gate answers "is this model acceptable overall," which is the decision-relevant unit
